ALGER — Le ministère de la Formation et: ALGIERS — The Ministry of Vocational Training and Education launched, Thursday evening, the channel “Mihan TV”, the first sectoral media initiative in Algeria. This platform aims to promote professions and professional training courses among young people and trainees.
Une chaîne dédiée à la valorisation des: A channel dedicated to promoting professions and career paths
Le ministère de la Formation et de l’Ens: The Ministry of Vocational Training and Education officially launched, Thursday July 24, 2026, the channel “Mihan TV” from the National Institute of Vocational Training and Education (INFEP) in El Biar. This audiovisual platform, the first of its kind in Algeria, is part of the guidelines of the President of the Republic, Abdelmadjid Tebboune, aimed at strengthening the visibility of the vocational training sector.
Lors du lancement, la ministre de la For: During the launch, the Minister of Vocational Training and Education, Nacima Arhab, stressed that “Mihan TV” aims to modernize the institutional communication of the sector. She detailed three main objectives: raising awareness of specialties and training programs, facilitating the professional integration of young people, and promoting entrepreneurship. The chain also intends to strengthen the sector's openness to its economic environment.
Une grille de programmes axée sur l’inno: A program schedule focused on innovation and integration
Nacima Arhab a précisé que « Mihan TV »: Nacima Arhab specified that “Mihan TV” will be hosted by a team of young professionals. From its launch, the channel offers varied programming including field reports, exclusive interviews with players in the sector, as well as the presentation of successful career paths of interns and graduates. This content aims to inspire young people and guide them towards training choices adapted to the needs of the job market.
La grille actuelle repose sur trois prog: The current schedule is based on three flagship programs:
« Rouad el Mihan » : met en avant les ex: “Rouad el Mihan”: highlights the successful experiences of graduates and entrepreneurs from professional training.
« Skill Scope » : présente les métiers,: “Skill Scope”: presents the professions, specialties, skills and professional opportunities available.
« ProChat » : accueille des spécialistes: “ProChat”: welcomes specialists to discuss professional training issues and market expectations.
La chaîne a démarré avec ces trois émiss: The channel started with these three shows and plans to enrich its programming for the next professional year, scheduled for October 4, 2026.
« Mihan TV » est accessible via sa plate: “Mihan TV” is accessible via its digital platform https://mi8an-tv.mvet.dz/ as well as on its social networks. The channel's mission is to cover all wilayas through field reports, highlighting local experiences and the skills of professional training establishments.
La ministre a insisté sur l’importance d: The minister insisted on the importance of this project in anchoring the image of vocational training as a strategic choice for young people. She also underlined that the chain is part of a dynamic of adaptation to economic changes and the demands of the labor market.
